title: Contexture: Runtime Context Eviction for High-Throughput Agent Serving
abstract: arXiv:2611.26980v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents such as Hermes, OpenClaw, and Codex repeatedly resend growing execution histories, increasing shared GPU key-value (KV) cache demand in high-bandwidth memory (HBM). We show that shared KV capacity limits agent-serving throughput. Existing context-reduction methods lack global cache-state visibility, while runtime KV managers lack tool-execution information. Tracing tokens to their originating tool operations reveals that later operations supersede earlier outputs and associated turns, identifying 64% of recorded final-history tokens as removal candidates.   We present Contexture, a harness- and model-agnostic architecture for runtime context eviction. Contexture separates the harness's full conversation history from the model's execution context, reducing subsequent requests' KV demand without modifying harness logic or model execution. translated_title: Contexture：面向高吞吐量智能体服务的运行时上下文淘汰
translated_abstract: 诸如Hermes、OpenClaw和Codex等LLM智能体会反复重发不断增长的执行历史，增加了高带宽内存（HBM）中共享GPU键值（KV）缓存的需求。我们证明了共享KV容量是限制智能体服务吞吐量的关键因素。现有的上下文缩减方法缺乏对全局缓存状态的可见性，而运行时KV管理器又缺乏工具执行信息。通过将词元追溯到其来源的工具操作，我们发现后续操作会取代早期的输出及其相关对话轮次，从而识别出最终历史记录中64%的词元可作为删除候选。我们提出了Contexture，一种与智能体框架和模型均无关的运行时上下文淘汰架构。Contexture将框架的完整对话历史与模型的执行上下文相分离，在不修改框架逻辑或模型执行的情况下减少后续请求的KV需求。它将工具执行信息与对共享KV缓存压力的全局可见性相结合，（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Contexture提出了一种与框架和模型无关的运行时上下文淘汰架构，通过将工具执行信息与全局KV缓存压力可见性相结合，识别出64%可删除的过时历史词元，在不修改框架逻辑或模型执行的情况下降低了KV缓存需求并提升智能体服务的吞吐量。
